# CI for the web app: lint and test on every push and pull request.
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write
env:
  NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096 # the test suite is large
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4 # pinned by tag
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
  test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        node: [20, 22]
    steps:
      - name: Check out
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test -- --coverage
        env:
          CI: "true"

# web: the front end, three replicas behind a ClusterIP service.
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: web-config
  namespace: shop
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  FEATURE_FLAGS: "checkout,search"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: shop
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  replicas: 3 # bump for launch
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/example/web:1.5.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: web-config
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
        - name: sidecar
          image: ghcr.io/example/log-shipper:0.9.0
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: shop
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
